previously_unproven: The post-recovery preflight could accept an up scrape sampled during the target-image interval rather than after the recovered Web started_at.

The target-period preservation report did not require its observation time, exact candidate/target commits, News identity, immutable Authority root check, read-only transaction and complete eight-rowset labels.
A failed target stop line triggered forward recovery but did not validate a separate post-recovery ledger/HTTPS stop line before reporting failure.
now_verified_by_code_and_isolated_tests: Both target and forward-recovery intervals require their own read-only eight-rowset preservation with exact News and Authority identity plus observation time after that interval's Web started_at.
Both intervals require authenticated TLS and a fresh web:8000 up=1 sample after their own Web started_at; a prior interval's up sample is rejected.

Recovery Docker started_at must be later than a known target started_at; an invalid target stop line still verifies current-image recovery, post-recovery ledger/TLS and the fresh diagnostic gate before emitting a DENY recovery checkpoint at exit code 1.
A nonempty raw TUI-02 migration vector still denies the live action before any Web switch.

verification.failing_first_operator_tests: 3 failures before the two-interval correction: missing recovery stop report, old target up accepted after recovery, and preservation observed before target start accepted.
